source: code/m1_pd_scorecard.sas: %let constants and the DATA SCORED step
factor_definition: pdo / ln(2) = 28.85390081777927; implemented rounded to 4 dp
offset_definition: base_score - factor * ln(base_odds) = 487.1228762045055; implemented rounded to 4 dp
score_formula: SCORE = ROUND(OFFSET + FACTOR * LOG((1 - PD_ADJ) / PD_ADJ), 1)
rounding: SAS ROUND to the nearest integer; halves are rounded away from zero

overrides.condition: LIMIT_BAL >= 500000 and DECISION = 'DECLINE' and DLQ_CUR < 2 and SCORE >= CUTOFF - 15

band_rule: first band in this list whose min_score <= SCORE; F otherwise
